value.syntax: # [doc = " JSON control-plane record kinds emitted on stderr."] # [derive (Debug , Clone , Copy , Serialize , Deserialize , PartialEq , Eq)] # [serde (rename_all = "snake_case")] pub enum ControlPlaneRecordKind { # [doc = " Help text requested by the caller."] Help , # [doc = " Version information requested by the caller."] Version , # [doc = " Command-line usage or argv parsing failure."] UsageError , # [doc = " Refusal to write stdout result data directly to a terminal."] TtyRefusal , # [doc = " Panic diagnostic emitted by the shared panic hook."] Panic , # [doc = " Non-error status update."] Status , # [doc = " Runtime diagnostic or error."] Diagnostic , }
